deep.reconstruction:
Context: the previous page proved, for a nondecreasing sequence r_ν with counting function n(r), that Σ λ(r_ν) < ∞ iff ∫ n(r)(−λ'(r)) dr < ∞ for decreasing C¹ λ. It also gave the Abel-summation identity Σ_{a<r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) = λ(b)n(b−0) − λ(a)n(a+0) + ∫_a^b n(r)(−λ'(r)) dr.

This page specialises to the case where r_ν are the moduli of the zeros of an entire function f.
- By the argument principle, n(r) = (1/2π)∫_0^{2π} f'(re^{iφ})/f(re^{iφ}) · re^{iφ} dφ.
- Multiply by a weight μ(r), integrate over [a,b] and apply Fubini. The inner integrand f'(re^{iφ})e^{iφ}/f(re^{iφ}) is ∂_r log f(re^{iφ}).
- Integrate by parts in r (μ assumed C¹). Grothendieck notes the branch-of-log issue, which he resolves by taking real parts. This replaces log f by log|f| and gives
  ∫_a^b n(r)μ(r) dr = [rμ(r)V(r)]_a^b − ∫_a^b V(r) d(rμ(r)),
  where V(r) = (1/2π)∫ log|f(re^{iφ})| dφ.
- This is just Jensen's formula in the form rV'(r) = n(r), followed by one integration by parts.
- Substituting μ = −λ' into the Abel-summation identity gives
  Σ_{a<r_ν<b} λ(r_ν) = λ(b)n(b−0) − λ(a)n(a+0) + [rμV]_a^b + ∫_a^b V d(rλ').

Purpose: bound weighted zero-counting sums Σ λ(r_ν) (e.g. λ(r) = r^{−α}) by the growth of the mean of log|f|. The next page bounds this via M(r) = max|f|. This is the classical Hadamard/Borel route from order of growth to the convergence exponent of zeros. In a 1953 functional-analysis file it almost certainly serves the eigenvalue estimates for nuclear/Fredholm operators: zeros of the Fredholm determinant det(I − zu) are reciprocals of eigenvalues. Those estimates appear in Grothendieck's 'Produits tensoriels topologiques' (1955) and 'La théorie de Fredholm' (1956).
errors: No substantive error on this page. The formulas check out: argument principle normalisation, ∂_r log f = f'e^{iφ}/f, and signs after setting μ = −λ' (giving [−rλ'V] + ∫V d(rλ')).

The branch issue for log f is handled only informally, by taking real parts. That is legitimate, since zeros lie on the radial paths for only finitely many φ (measure zero) and log|f| is locally integrable.

Next page (not this one): the claim |V(r)| ≤ M(r) is inaccurate. The correct statements are V(r) ≤ log M(r) and V(r) ≥ log|f(0)| (Jensen; V is increasing). Also, a minus sign appears to be missing before bλ'(b)V(b).

ideas.what: Expressing ∫ n(r)μ(r) dr through the circular mean V(r) of log|f| by argument principle, Fubini and integration by parts
ideas.modern_name: Jensen's formula (rV'(r) = n(r), V(r) = log|f(0)| + N(r)) / Nevanlinna counting function
ideas.usually_credited_to: J. L. W. V. Jensen (1899); Nevanlinna (1920s)
ideas.where_published: Possibly implicit in the estimates of 'La théorie de Fredholm' (Bull. SMF 84, 1956)

ideas.what: Bounding weighted sums Σλ(r_ν) over zeros by the growth of f (Stieltjes/Abel summation against the counting function)
ideas.modern_name: Hadamard–Borel relation between order of growth and convergence exponent of zeros
ideas.where_published: Used for eigenvalue summability of nuclear operators via Fredholm determinants in Produits tensoriels (Memoirs AMS 16, 1955) / La théorie de Fredholm (1956), if this is indeed the application

deep.surprise_reason: A careful, self-derived version of Jensen's formula with a general weight, recorded as a classical tool, presumably for the published Fredholm-determinant eigenvalue estimates. Nothing new.
transcription_corrections: 'On devrait évidemment la détermination principale' likely reads 'On devrait évidemment prendre la détermination principale du logarithme — pour ce faire ... car les intégrales ... intervenant sont convergentes'. The parenthetical is partly illegible.
The leading 2π in the boxed formula is struck out in the image, consistent with V carrying the factor 1/2π.
There is an illegible marginal note at left beside the drawn circle (something like '... valables'), not captured.
The sum on the last formula is indexed 'r_ν, a<r_ν<b'. The superscript after λ(r_ν) looks like a stray mark, not an exponent α.
